title: Rate-Limited Notification Fan-Out
hints: Spawn one worker task per channel. Each worker owns its channel's queue and its own last-start time, so channels never wait on each other.
Pick the queued item with the smallest (ready_time, seq), then start at max(now, ready_time, last_start + interval). Retries are attempts too, so they count against the interval.
On a ToolError, do not sleep in place: push the subscriber back with ready_time = finish + retry_delay * 2**(attempt - 1) so others on the channel go first.
BadRequestError is permanent. Record it as rejected and never retry it.
